text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Risk coverage for thermal networks and long-term storage", "gist": "The text discusses risk coverage for thermal networks and long-term storage"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "June 18th 2023", "gist": "Date the Climate and Innovation Act was adopted by popular vote"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "January 1st 2025", "gist": "Date the Climate and Innovation Act entered into force"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Climate and Innovation Act", "gist": "The law providing for risk coverage and other measures"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The law provides for the introduction of a hedge for risks associated with investments in public infrastructure projects required to achieve the net-zero goal (art. 7 Climate and Innovation Act)", "gist": "The Climate and Innovation Act introduces a risk hedge for net-zero infrastructure investments"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This includes thermal networks and long-term thermal storage, which can be covered by part of the financial resources made available for the promotion of new technologies and processes (art. 6 Climate and Innovation Act)", "gist": "Thermal networks and long-term storage are covered by funds for new technologies under the Act"}]}
